description: This file defines debugging utilities and macros for the Android media framework, including status code string conversion, debug level management, and experiment flag handling.

classes.name: ADebug
classes.description: Class providing debug level management, string conversion for status codes, and experiment flag handling.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Converts status_t codes to human-readable strings.

methods.name: GetLevelFromSettingsString
methods.description: Parses a string to determine the debug level for a component.

methods.name: GetLevelFromProperty
methods.description: Retrieves debug level from property string.

methods.name: GetDebugLevelFromProperty
methods.description: Gets debug level with clamping to valid range.

methods.name: GetDebugName
methods.description: Returns a debug-friendly name for a codec.

methods.name: isExperimentEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific experiment is enabled based on configuration.
